- The modification in `ZNode.java` indicates a shift from using a method (`SetChild`) to directly assigning the parent node to an instance variable. This change likely addresses a bug introduced in a previous commit (referenced as `800f8fb716694`), suggesting that the previous method call may have been causing issues with the parent-child relationship in the node structure. The new assignment method is more straightforward and may resolve the bug by ensuring that the parent node is correctly referenced without additional method overhead.
